# NIST ACVP known-answer vectors for ML-KEM (FIPS 203).
#
# Source: NIST's own ACVP-Server repository,
#   https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server
# retrieved 2026-09-15 from branch master at commit
# 975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d (2026-08-12), files
#   gen-val/json-files/ML-KEM-keyGen-FIPS203/internalProjection.json
#     (last changed by commit 15c0f3deeefbfa8cb6cd32a99e1ca3b738c66bf0,
#     2026-04-16, "RELEASE/v1.1.0.42")
#   gen-val/json-files/ML-KEM-encapDecap-FIPS203/internalProjection.json
#     (last changed by commit ad33b3d9504491767f1aa76382464f3b3fa2359e,
#     2026-07-28, "corrects ML-KEM encapDecap tests that included `ek` that
#     were longer than intended")
# Both files carry vsId 42.
#
# Every value is copied verbatim from the JSON (upper-case hexadecimal, as
# published); nothing was edited. Each key name below ends in the JSON field
# it holds. The cases, by test group and test case identifier:
#   MLKEM512_KEYGEN_*: keyGen tgId 1 tcId 1 (d, z, ek, dk)
#   MLKEM512_ENCAP_*: encapDecap tgId 1 tcId 1 (ek, m, c, k; the case's dk is not copied)
#   MLKEM512_DECAP_VALID_*: encapDecap tgId 4 tcId 79, reason "valid decapsulation" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM512_DECAP_MODIFIED_*: encapDecap tgId 4 tcId 76, reason "modified ciphertext" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM512_DKCHECK_MODIFIED_H_DK: encapDecap tgId 7 tcId 106, reason "modified H", testPassed false (dk)
#   MLKEM512_EKCHECK_TOO_LARGE_EK: encapDecap tgId 8 tcId 117, reason "noisy linear system values too large", testPassed false (ek)
#   MLKEM768_KEYGEN_*: keyGen tgId 2 tcId 26 (d, z, ek, dk)
#   MLKEM768_ENCAP_*: encapDecap tgId 2 tcId 26 (ek, m, c, k; the case's dk is not copied)
#   MLKEM768_DECAP_VALID_*: encapDecap tgId 5 tcId 86, reason "valid decapsulation" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM768_DECAP_MODIFIED_*: encapDecap tgId 5 tcId 88, reason "modified ciphertext" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM768_DKCHECK_MODIFIED_H_DK: encapDecap tgId 9 tcId 128, reason "modified H", testPassed false (dk)
#   MLKEM768_EKCHECK_TOO_LARGE_EK: encapDecap tgId 10 tcId 137, reason "noisy linear system values too large", testPassed false (ek)
#   MLKEM1024_KEYGEN_*: keyGen tgId 3 tcId 51 (d, z, ek, dk)
#   MLKEM1024_ENCAP_*: encapDecap tgId 3 tcId 51 (ek, m, c, k; the case's dk is not copied)
#   MLKEM1024_DECAP_VALID_*: encapDecap tgId 6 tcId 97, reason "valid decapsulation" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM1024_DECAP_MODIFIED_*: encapDecap tgId 6 tcId 96, reason "modified ciphertext" (dk, c, k; the case's ek, which dk embeds, is not copied)
#   MLKEM1024_DKCHECK_MODIFIED_H_DK: encapDecap tgId 11 tcId 146, reason "modified H", testPassed false (dk)
#   MLKEM1024_EKCHECK_TOO_LARGE_EK: encapDecap tgId 12 tcId 159, reason "noisy linear system values too large", testPassed false (ek)
#
# A "modified ciphertext" case's k is the implicit-rejection value
# J(z || c) of FIPS 203 Algorithm 18, z being the last 32 bytes of dk. A
# "modified H" dk fails the FIPS 203 section 7.3 hash check, and a "noisy
# linear system values too large" ek fails the section 7.2 modulus check.
